description:
Creates a new FTP account

HTTP: POST /v1/ftp-accounts
Category: FTP
Required scopes: ftp:write
Returns: {status, data: any}
Mutating: changes server state.

domain_id.description: UUID of a domain of the owning account (alternative to user_id) — obtain it from GET /v1/domains

ftp_username.description: FTP login name (required unless username is given)

home_directory.description: Directory the login is confined to, inside the account's home (default: the account's home directory)

quota_mb.description: Disk quota in megabytes for this FTP login

user_id.description: UUID of the owning account — obtain it from GET /v1/accounts; resolved from domain_id when omitted, else the key's own account

name: panelica_ftp_post_v1_ftp_accounts
